basis: Direct user request to repair the whole system rather than accept capability regression. Previous finite cohorts remain closed and immutable.
scope: Source fixes and saved-state static diagnostics first; no hosted model, hardware or qualification authority.

static_trim_diagnostic.sample_selection: nearest saved ballistic_return sample to97700m and60000m; earliest index on tie; nointerpolation
static_trim_diagnostic.goal: Re-evaluate existing static trim using actual saved state and actual vehicle; record why root is unavailable and do not assign predicted states to plant.

source_repair_boundaries.ascent: explicit distinct first-burn and final-insertion objectives; default legacy/v2/v3 unchanged; no finalgate relaxation
source_repair_boundaries.booster: infeasible fuel-exhausted forecast cannot masquerade as feasible stopping height; explicitbounded fallback request
source_repair_boundaries.ship: record every statictrim failure and its measured context; preserve actual pose/flap dynamics
source_repair_boundaries.numerics: separate controller polling/allocator horizon from physical substeps; preserve old dt_scale results and labels

new_sixdof_cohort.status: not_registered_not_started;freeze repaired source and a separate finite physical diagnostic before any integration

termination: static solver timeout, source/hash mismatch or invalidrecord stops without retry; persistent source record remains untouched
cleanup: retain source/results and rawrecords; compress and restoreverify before any future deletion; no Dockerresources
